steps.speaker: hero
steps.text: The cell is open. You are Roxana?

steps.speaker: roxana
steps.text: I am. And you took your time, General. Three years I counted the cracks in that wall.

steps.speaker: hero
steps.text: A dying man in Rome told me you know how the Iron Crown was made.

steps.speaker: roxana
steps.text: I do. The Crown was not forged from any metal of this earth. It was beaten from the shards of a fallen star.

steps.speaker: roxana
steps.text: Every shard still carries that fire. That is why the Crown's servants hunt them, and why the Shahbanu kept me in chains.

steps.speaker: bashir
steps.text: A star's metal... No mason's chisel was ever meant to cut that.

steps.speaker: roxana
steps.text: Chisels are for patient men. Fire and blasting powder are my craft. I have brought down walls older than yours.

steps.speaker: roxana
steps.text: Give me fire, General, and I will give you open gates.

steps.speaker: titus
steps.text: I like her. She talks the way I fight.

steps.speaker: hero
steps.text: Then you ride with us, Roxana. The Shahbanu's walls are waiting.
